brand_kit.name: Northwind Outdoor
brand_kit.tone_of_voice: Calm, practical and grounded. We talk like an experienced guide: short sentences, concrete details about materials and conditions, no hype, no exclamation marks, no all-caps shouting. Invite people outdoors without pressure.
brand_kit.logo_rules: The Northwind compass mark appears in Summit Red or white only. Keep clear space around the mark equal to its height. Never place the mark on busy photographic areas, never stretch, rotate or add effects. Minimum size 48 px.

assets.title: Ridge Jacket hero
assets.description: Hero image for the Ridge insulated jacket, fall launch.

versions.alt_text: Hiker in a red insulated jacket on a rocky ridge above a pine valley at dawn.
versions.prompt: Outdoor apparel advertising photo: a hiker wearing a deep red insulated puffer jacket with a visible front zipper, standing on a granite ridge, pine forest valley below, soft dawn light, muted natural colors, photorealistic, no text, no logos.

versions.alt_text: Hiker in a red insulated jacket on a rocky ridge, framed closer, pine valley behind.
versions.prompt: Outdoor apparel advertising photo, medium close-up: a hiker wearing a deep red insulated puffer jacket with a clearly visible front zipper and chest pocket, granite rocks, blurred pine forest valley behind, overcast soft light, muted natural colors, photorealistic, no text, no logos.
